_how_to: One config per reaction for plant_framework.py. Replace every <...>. Every number gets an entry in 'sources' (URL or DOI + where in it); a value you could not source is still filled, marked 'assumption' in sources, and listed in 'uncertain' with a low/high range. Units are fixed by the key names. Costs are per tonne of the product.
name: <reaction name>

thermo.dH_J_mol: <reaction enthalpy per mol key reactant as written, J/mol, + endothermic>
thermo.dS_J_molK: <reaction entropy, J/mol/K; dG = dH - T dS gives K in bar^(sum nu)>

feed_ratio.<co-feed species>: <mol per mol key reactant at the reactor inlet>

plant.approach: <highest per-pass conversion as a fraction of equilibrium, e.g. 0.9>
plant.overall_conv: <overall conversion of the key reactant in the plant after recycle/staging, usually 0.98-1.0>

lab_feed.default_y_key: <key-reactant mole fraction to assume when a paper gives none>

default_ratio.<co-feed species>: <co-feed per key to assume when a paper gives none>

switches.selectivity_loss: <'lost' if by-products leave the plant (feed per tonne product = 1/S), 'converted_downstream' if they are recycled/converted to product>

fixed_credits.name: <by-product sold or burnt>
fixed_credits.GJ_per_t: <fuel value; credit = t x GJ x gas price>

lost_key_fuel_GJ_per_t: <fuel value of the key reactant lost to by-products, GJ/t, or 0>

energy.pay_reaction_heat: <true for endothermic reactions heated by fired heaters>
energy.e_proc_GJ_per_t_reactor_feed: <fuel GJ per t of key reactant through the reactors: reheating, separation, compression>
energy.power_kWh_per_t_recycle: <kWh per t fresh feed per unit recycle ratio>

capex.usd: <installed capital of the reference plant, USD>
capex.reactor_basis: <'throughput' (reactor sized by flow, regeneration off-stream time) or 'catalyst' (sized by catalyst inventory)>

regeneration.enabled: <true if the catalyst is regenerated in cycles>

reference.name: <industrial catalyst/process>
reference.r: <kg product per kg catalyst per h in the plant>

finance.fixed_om_frac: <fixed O&M per year as fraction of capex>

metal_usd_per_kg.<element>: <USD per kg contained element; every element in the catalysts you will cost>
